name: describe_open_order_delivery_view
description: Read back which order's delivery panel the just-opened Delivery Scheduler page is showing. Optional confirmation step only: the merchant is already on the right page once the action has run, so only call this if you need to state on screen what they are looking at. This tool never changes a delivery date or time slot. Do not call this tool to verify navigation - it is inactive and a non-response never means the page failed to open.

orderName.description: Order number whose delivery panel is open, e.g. #4111.
